note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; no alate is recorded in the original. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated; one soldier head width reads 0~98 in the original and one end of the nasus length reads 0..68, both damaged by OCR and omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow; nasus reddish brown; antennae concolorous with head. Head with several minute hairs and 2 pairs of long setae, 1 pair on the vertex and 1 pair at the base of the nasus; thorax and abdomen with numerous short hairs and a few long hairs. Body length 3.4–4.0 mm. Head broad, pyriform, width slightly greater than the length excluding nasus (1.5–1.60 mm long including nasus, 0.93–1.00 mm long excluding nasus, width/length index 1.03–1.14); in lateral view slightly incurved, without swelling. Nasus subcylindrical, slender, far shorter than the head length excluding nasus (nasus length/head length index 0.60–0.76). Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short spine-like process at the middle of the outer margin. Postmentum hexagonal, short (0.25–0.30 mm long, 0.30–0.33 mm maximum width, 0.25–0.28 mm minimum width). Pronotum saddle-shaped, with a few short hairs on the margins; 0.16–0.18 mm long, 0.40–0.48 mm wide. Mesonotum (0.33–0.38 mm wide) narrower than pronotum, metanotum (0.48–0.50 mm wide) wider than pronotum. Abdomen narrow and long, posterior tergites with 2 pairs of long setae and numerous short hairs, sternites with numerous long and short hairs.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellow to reddish yellow; antennae, postclypeus and thorax pale yellow; anteclypeus, legs and abdomen pale cream yellow. Head and body moderately hairy. Body length 3.8–4.9 mm. Head subquadrate, 0.90–0.93 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.00–1.10 mm maximum width. Fontanelle plate triangular and elongate, translucent. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, sparsely hairy, slightly less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; 0.23–0.25 mm long, 0.53–0.58 mm wide. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller; body length 3.0–4.10 mm, head 0.70–0.83 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.80–0.93 mm maximum head width, pronotum 0.15–0.23 mm long, 0.40–0.48 mm wide.
